title: diffContractSnapshots
responsibility: Reserves stable uid matches before fallback id joins, preserving renames alongside retired old-id tombstones; filters fields and counts material or ignored changes.

inputs.name: diffContractSnapshots.before
inputs.description: Earlier complete stored-contract snapshot. Stable uid matches take priority over id fallback, including when the later snapshot retains uid-less old-id tombstones.

inputs.name: diffContractSnapshots.after
inputs.description: Later complete stored-contract snapshot; its retained uids are reserved before id fallback so file ordering cannot consume a renamed unit earlier in the join.

inputs.name: diffContractSnapshots.options
inputs.description: Contract and field filters plus the display row limit. Snapshot selectors are resolved before this comparison; summary counts precede the display limit.

inputs.name: validateHistoryFields.field
inputs.description: Empty or omitted means no field restriction; otherwise comma-separated type, description, examples, errors and dependencies categories. Unsupported categories are rejected.

outputs.name: diffContractSnapshots
outputs.description: Changes joined by global uid priority then unreserved id fallback, with field-kind counts, ignored files, total and truncation state. UID-less rename tombstones remain separate added records.

outputs.name: validateHistoryFields
outputs.description: No value; accepts omitted or supported comma-separated field categories and throws for any unsupported category.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Unsupported field category or a folder outside the project root is rejected; the comparison itself performs no source or filesystem reads.
